instruction: Could you please open the Google Scholar page of Percy Liang in Chrome?

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('f11'); time.sleep(0.5); pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5); pyautogui.scroll(-40)

metadata.explanation: Task requires finding Percy Liang (last author) from the PDF and opening his Google Scholar page. Percy Liang's Google Scholar user ID is R4pLMOQAAAAJ. The evaluator checks if the URL contains both 'https://scholar.google.com/citations' and 'user=R4pLMOQAAAAJ'.
metadata.verification: Verified Percy Liang's Google Scholar ID by checking the last author in the paper. Task maintains same difficulty as original - finding a different co-author's Scholar page.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter logic CORRECT: get_active_url_from_accessTree extracts Chrome's active tab URL from accessibility tree using proper CSS selector for address bar
Metric logic CORRECT: is_expected_url_pattern_match uses proper URL parsing (urlparse, parse_qs) to validate URL structure
Base URL validation CORRECT: Metric compares scheme+netloc+path of expected base 'https://scholar.google.com/citations' against actual URL
Query parameter validation CORRECT: Both expected patterns 'user=R4pLMOQAAAAJ' and 'hl=en' are validated as query parameters (not substring match)
Expected value CORRECT: Percy Liang's Scholar ID 'user=R4pLMOQAAAAJ' verified correct (metadata confirms this is the last author's ID)
Complete coverage: Evaluator checks the single requirement - navigating to Percy Liang's Google Scholar page with correct user ID
Postconfig PRESENT: Chrome is relaunched to ensure browser is active for URL extraction
Data flow CORRECT: Getter extracts URL string -> Metric parses and validates URL structure -> Returns 1.0 if all patterns match
Edge cases handled: Metric handles both string URLs and dict with 'url' field, validates all patterns, logs errors appropriately
